title: test certs expire 2036-04-29; fixed UNIX_EPOCH+1_893_456_000 will become stale
description: smime_tests.rs: tests use a hard-coded timestamp 1_893_456_000 (2029-12-31 roughly) to stay within cert validity. However certs expire 2036-04-29. When cert regeneration occurs (a routine ops task), the new validity window may not include 1_893_456_000 or a future committer may regenerate certs without updating the constant. Add a comment above each UNIX_EPOCH + Duration::from_secs(1_893_456_000) usage saying 'Must be within cert validity 2026-05-02 to 2036-04-29' so regen checklist is clear.
close_reason: Cert expiry 2036 is 10+ years away. No action needed now; can be regenerated when needed.
